name: Specular 高light
algorithm: Specular 高light — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes specular highlights for deepfake detection:

1. **Highlight検出**: Specular highlights (bright spots from direct light reflection) are detected across the frame on all surfaces — skin, eyes, glasses, jewelry, objects. Highlights are identified by local maximum intensity exceeding neighbors by a threshold.

2. **Highlight-光Source一貫性**: All specular highlights in the scene should be consistent with the same light source configuration. Using highlight positions and surface geometry, the method estimates implied light directions. All highlights should point to consistent light source positions. Deepfakes may produce highlights with inconsistent implied light directions.

3. **HighlightShape分析**: The shape of specular highlights encodes surface curvature — highlights on flat surfaces appear as points, on curved surfaces as elongated reflections following surface curvature. The method checks highlight shapes against estimated surface geometry. AI-generated highlights may have shapes inconsistent with the underlying geometry.

4. **HighlightIntensity&Physics**: Specular highlight intensity follows the Fresnel equations — brighter at grazing angles, with material-dependent characteristics. The method verifies highlight intensity follows physical reflectance models. AI generators may produce highlights with incorrect intensity patterns.

5. **時間的HighlightDynamics**: As objects move, specular highlights should move according to the changing reflection angle. The method tracks highlight motion — highlights should move faster than texture features for convex surfaces (virtual image effect). Incorrect highlight dynamics indicate AI generation without proper reflectance modeling.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through specular highlight analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
